findings.message: Content centre is (12.00, 11.75); the house spec is (12, 12) within 0.25. Shift by (0.00, 0.25) unless the icons this one swaps with sit here too.

"e2" has an edge at 126.9°, 8.1° off the nearest permitted axis (135°), and the program declared `off-axis` for it. Nothing to fix — confirm the diagonal is the drawing. Off-axis edges are 29.3% of the set's stroked icons, so this is the set's own habit rather than drift.

unresolved.description: The filled head-to-handle separation fails the selected 1.5-unit minimum gap: the final checker measures 1.25 units. In the final 16px proof the diagonal separator is soft and does not sustain a fully clear native pixel at its narrow section; filled native rows[9][5]=184 and rows[9][6]=124, while the corresponding retina separator is much clearer (rows[19][11]=252).

The handle attachment does not preserve the reference hammer's central seating and consistent proportions across paints. The outlined enlarged proof shows a thickened rounded shoulder near the head's lower-left end; its resolved handle starts at (6.5,13.6969), beside the head's end at (6.9159,13.9152). The filled proof instead has a separated, shorter handle seated farther down. Both read as hammers, but this shoulder and attachment mismatch remains visible in enlarged and 2x proofs.
